content: The fish trap exists because of the fish. Once you've gotten the fish you can forget the trap. Words exist because of meaning. Once you've gotten the meaning, you can forget the words.
author: Zhuangzi
sourceWork: The Book of Zhuangzi, Chapter 26 (External Things)
explanation: Language, doctrines, and concepts are merely scaffolding. Zhuangzi warns against falling in love with religious or philosophical vocabulary while missing the living reality to which words point.
practicalInsight: Look past the exact phrasing of someone's complaint or request today and listen directly to the core human emotion beneath their words.
reflectionPrompt: What theoretical concept or label are you obsessing over while ignoring the direct experiential reality in front of you?
